scope: Maintainer-requested fresh qualification retry of the exact previously inconclusive ordinary completion-notification candidate. No new Rust policy, no diagnostic captures, no pooling with the earlier cohort.
configuration: Fresh local ext4 databases; v7 Parallel,1KiB values,2GiB SST,no compaction. Batch64 uses750000 puts/sample10;point8/16 use100000/sample100;point1 uses20000/sample10. Exact saved baseline/candidate binaries, no new release build.
schedule: First batch16 guard:2 warmups+5 alternating pairs, minimum3 matched. If it passes, run point8 independent confirmation:2 warmups+5 pairs and four guards point1,point16,batch8,batch1:2 warmups+3 pairs each. Finish every enabled followup regardless of interim results. Maximum56 invocations, no replacement pairs, no pooling or subsequent score-selected retries. Stop on capture or audit errors.
cooldown: 60s before each cell and15s between invocations; no overlapping builds/tests/profiles/source edits or SSD health polling.
stall_policy: Unchanged: flag mean FRONTIER write>=1ms OR mean fdatasync>=1.5ms; exclude whole pair if either arm is flagged. Preserve all raw records. This aggregate mask misses short outliers and cannot isolate source effects from storage variation.
assessment: Batch16 needs>=3 matched pairs; other guards>=2. Guard paired and arm-median throughput>=0.95 and paired p99<=1.10. Point8 independent confirmation needs>=3 pairs, paired and arm-median throughput>1 and paired p99<1. Identical DATA bytes throughout. CPU/RSS diagnostic. Retain only if all six cells complete and pass; otherwise restore baseline source/canonical executable.
validation: Reapply byte-identical saved patch to the128-input baseline, fresh focused tests without retries and full cargo make check outside sandbox. Reuse existing candidate binary only after verifying original build/check provenance and128-input candidate hash identity.
publication: Accepted Rust change gets its own local commit; evidence separate. Failed/inconclusive retry gets evidence-only commit. No push/PR; stop for review.
